scope.title: Marketplace audit and 30-day plan
items: Full review of current listings, pricing, advertising, reviews, and account health on each active marketplace.
Written findings and a prioritized 30-day action plan delivered in the first two weeks.

scope.title: Listing and catalog optimization
items: Titles, bullets, A+ content, imagery briefs, and backend keywords for the priority catalog.
Variation and parent-child structure cleanup where it is costing rank or conversion.

scope.title: Advertising management
items: Campaign structure, bids, budgets, and weekly optimization across Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display.
Monthly efficiency review against agreed ACoS and TACoS targets.

scope.title: Brand protection
items: Unauthorized-seller and MAP monitoring with a documented enforcement path.
Brand Registry, listing-hijack, and suppression issue handling with the marketplace.

scope.title: Reporting and cadence
items: Weekly scorecard: sales, ad efficiency, buy box, inventory position, account health.
Biweekly working session with your team; monthly review of results against plan.

pricing.notes: The retainer covers strategy, execution, and reporting across the marketplaces listed in the scope. Ad spend, marketplace fees, and third-party tools are paid by the client directly.

terms: The monthly retainer is invoiced on the first of each month, due net 15.
The performance fee is calculated monthly from the marketplace sales reports the client shares and invoiced in arrears with the next retainer.
The initial term is the number of months shown above, after which the engagement continues month to month with 30 days' written notice from either side.
The client owns all marketplace accounts, listings, content, and data. Chief Marketplace Officer keeps its methods, templates, and tooling.
Advertising spend, marketplace fees, and any third-party tools are billed to and paid by the client directly.
Either side may end the engagement for a material breach that is not fixed within 15 days of written notice.
Both sides keep the other's non-public information confidential during and after the engagement.
